description.zh: 把「选择 / 分类 / 评分」交给 Jev 的类型化判断：输入框开关 + 系统提示词注入 + jev_decide / jev_reference 两个工具。无 key 时降级为如实标注的模拟模式，绝不编造概率。
description.en: Typed decisions for your agent: an input-menu toggle, a system-prompt hook, and the jev_decide / jev_reference tools. Falls back to an explicitly labelled simulation when no API key is set.

description.zh: 向 Jev 提交类型化判断题（choice / noul / score），返回答案与用量；未配 key 时返回模拟标注。
description.en: Submit typed questions to Jev (choice / noul / score) and get answers plus usage; labelled simulation when no key is set.

description.zh: 离线查阅 Jev 的请求格式、题型规则、返回字段与边界说明。
description.en: Offline reference for the Jev request format, question types, response fields and limits.
